text: こんどは　すごく　かてるきが　するぞ！

structure.jp: すごく　かてるきが　するぞ！
structure.en: I really feel like I can win!

patterns.name: 〜気がする
patterns.span: かてるきが　するぞ
patterns.explanation: きがする after a verb says you have a feeling that it is so. かてるきが　する = 'I feel like I can win'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing かつ to かてる turns 'win' into 'can win'. かてる = 'can win'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful way of stating something, mostly used by men and boys. かてるきが　するぞ = 'I feel like I can win, I tell you!'.
